verdict.rationale: Vue's core value proposition is a compiler-optimized, fine-grained reactivity system where declaring reactive state (ref/reactive) automatically tracks dependencies so only affected DOM updates re-run, explicitly documented as 'truly reactive, compiler-optimized rendering system that rarely requires manual optimization,' and independently praised by community members as more ergonomic than alternatives for state handling. Missing for 10: no hands-on benchmark or granular technical walkthrough of the dependency-tracking mechanism in the evidence, and some community comments raise reasoning/debugging concerns about implicit reactivity rather than confirming re-render scoping precisely.
